column2: Stand up 3-broker Kafka cluster for events-pipeline
column3: Per ADR-0003. Size for ~3k events/s peak with 7-day retention.

column2: Schema registry for events-pipeline topics
column3: Avro schemas with compatibility checks so producers can't break consumers.
column11: 2026-02-06 16:00;Priya Raman;Registry live; all payments topics registered.

column2: Consumer lag alerting for events-pipeline
column3: Alert when any consumer group lags more than 5 minutes.

column2: Tune retention to 7 days on replayable topics
column3: Per ADR-0003 replay requirement; compacted topics for projections.

column2: Kafka broker rolling upgrade to 3.8
column3: Rolling upgrade with zero downtime; document the procedure.
column11: 2026-03-20 15:30;Priya Raman;Done. Procedure is in the runbook, but it needs someone who knows the controller quirks.

column2: Move dispatch events onto events-pipeline
column3: Migrate dispatch-api from direct HTTP callbacks to Kafka topics.

column2: Partition rebalancing playbook
column3: Write down how to move partitions off a sick broker.
column11: 2026-06-20 11:00;Priya Raman;Didn't get to this before my last day, sorry. Notes are in the runbook draft.

column2: Handover: events-pipeline ownership to Lena
column3: Knowledge transfer before Priya leaves.
column11: 2026-06-29 16:00;Lena Fischer;Two shadow sessions done; still uncomfortable with broker recovery.

column2: Solver: add driver break constraints
column3: Drivers must take a 30 minute break after 4.5 hours.

column2: Solver: vehicle capacity by volume, not count
column3: Model parcel volume so vans aren't overfilled.

column2: Solver parameter tuning for large depots
column3: First-solution strategy and local search limits per depot size.

column2: Events pipeline outage 2026-07-14: ISR shrink and consumer lag
column3: Two brokers dropped out of ISR during the promotion peak (~11k events/s). Recovery took ~5 hours because nobody on call had done partition leader re-election before.

column2: Evaluate Amazon MSK vs Kinesis for events-pipeline
column3: After the July outage we no longer have in-house Kafka operations experience. Compare managed options; consumers should not need rewrites.
column11: 2026-08-12 11:00;Diego Alvarez;MSK cost is ~1.4x self-managed but removes broker ops; Kinesis would require rewriting 14 consumers.

column2: Migrate events-pipeline to Amazon MSK
column3: Per ADR-0011. Mirror topics with MirrorMaker 2, cut over consumers one by one.
column11: 2026-09-15 12:00;Yuki Tanaka;Payments and dispatch topics mirrored, consumers cut over.

column2: Idempotency for Stripe webhooks
column3: Store idempotency key per Stripe event in Redis (24h TTL) as agreed in #payments.

column2: Customer charged twice after a dispute webhook
column3: Duplicate charge on order 88412. The dispute webhook was resent by Stripe ~3 days after the first delivery; our idempotency key (24h TTL) had expired.
column11: 2026-05-06 11:00;Arjun Mehta;Stripe resends dispute events for up to 72 hours, so a 24h TTL cannot cover disputes.
column12: 2026-05-14 15:40;Arjun Mehta;Dispute keys now kept 7 days; unique constraint on (stripe_event_id) added in ledger-db.

column2: Replace greedy routing heuristic with OR-Tools
column3: Per RFC-0007: model hard time windows.
column11: 2026-03-27 16:00;Marcus Bell;Rolled out to all depots. Time-window violations down from 18% to 0.6%.

column2: Optimizer times out on 1,200-stop Saturday batch
column3: Solver exceeds the 60s budget for the largest depot on Saturdays.
column11: 2026-08-21 10:00;Marcus Bell;Pairing with Pavel; first-solution strategy PATH_CHEAPEST_ARC plus guided local search gets it to 41s.

column2: Driver app: React Native skeleton
column3: Per ADR-0005.

column2: ANRs on low-end Android in map screen
column3: ANR rate 4.1% on 2 GB RAM devices; map screen renders 150+ markers at ~15 fps.
column11: 2026-05-22 14:00;Jordan Lee;Native map module shipped (ADR-0012); ANR rate down to 0.3%.

column2: JWT access + refresh tokens for drivers
column3: Per ADR-0006: 15 min access tokens, 8h refresh tokens.

column2: Refresh token rotation
column3: Security review: rotate refresh tokens on use and detect reuse.

column2: Switch EU SMS to MessageBird
column3: ~40% cheaper per SMS in the EU.

column2: Brazil SMS delivery rate on MessageBird
column3: Pilot shows 81% delivery vs 97% on Twilio. Keep Twilio for Brazil.

column2: Build in-house feature flag service
column3: Per RFC-0009: boolean flags, percentage rollouts, per-tenant overrides.
